fact: The ANDF's information systems director reported at CITA 2026 that e-Terre manages title issuance online through the national services portal and that e-Foncier Bénin has covered Cotonou, Porto-Novo and Parakou in full plus nine other communes in part.
title: Tribune de haut niveau des experts du numérique et du foncier
publisher: Académie Nationale des Sciences, Arts et Lettres du Bénin
